title: Conductor shift handover + dependency map (2026-03-10)
content:
Meeting: Release Conductor daily handover
Date: 2026-03-10 09:30 PT
Attendees: Aisha F. (conductor day), Marco L. (oncall infra), Priya N. (release engineer), Evan B. (SRE), Sofia G. (product deployments)
Purpose: quick sync between conductor shifts + capture dependency map for next two release trains and outstanding hotfixes. Goal is a single source-of-truth handover note for the evening conductor.

SUMMARY HIGHLIGHTS
- Hotfix queue: three items open, one blocking customer (INFR-1299). Patch prepared, needs smoke window and model-serving kernel backport.
- Train cadence: Next minor ship (v1.13) scheduled Thu 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC; canary window 02:00–06:00 UTC on dedicated pools in us-west1.
- Dependency map captured below — callouts for infra changes that must land before canary (KV cache persistent warmup, NPU driver pin on dedicated hosts).
- Rollout decision: delay non-blocking optimizer PR (serving-runtime PR#412) from canary to next patch to reduce blast radius; it will be gated behind a separate opt-in rollout to dedicated beta tenants.

DETAILED NOTES
1) Hotfixes and patch status
   - INFR-1299 (customer-facing inference timeout): patch branch created, integration tests green locally, failing one e2e in staging due to a transient network flake. Marco to run repro matrix and coordinate network team. Current risk: P1 for the affected customer.
   - RELENG-842 (failed rollout during ramp): rollback applied successfully; postmortem draft started, root cause appears to be mis-sized instance type in autoscaler policy. Priya to complete postmortem and propose autoscaler guardrail.
   - HOT-311 (minor datadog dashboards regression): low severity, scheduled for next Monday maintenance window.

2) Canary/rollout windows and constraints
   - v1.13 canary window: Thu 03/12 02:00–06:00 UTC (us-west1 dedicated pool). Canary targets: 3% traffic initially, 15% after 30m if error/latency within SLO.
   - Canary preconditions checklist (must be green before gating):
     * KV cache persistent warmup job completed for models used by customers in beta (ticket: INFR-1307).
     * Autoscaler policy validated for 1.25x peak qps on canary slice.
     * Nightly metrics baseline capture completed (SLO baselines uploaded to console).
   - Note: PR 412 (quantization-kernel selector) removed from this canary — will be validated in a separate small-batch experiment.

3) Dependency map (high-level)
   - Serving-runtime PR#398 (KV cache warmup): must land + migration completed before canary ramp. Blockers: schema migration requires a maintenance window or live migration path.
   - infra-ops: NPU driver pin for dedicated hosts (REQ 2026-02-25) — pending host reimaging in us-west1; SRE has scheduled host updates Tue 03/10–03/11.
   - Billing/console: new quota enforcement change (billing-service PR#77) will change rate-limits for bulk inference; product confirmed no impact for canary but must be monitored.

4) Risk register (top 5)
   - Kernel mismatch on dedicated hosts causing model crashes (mitigation: driver pin + rollback playbook). Owner: Marco L.
   - Staging e2e flakes masking real regressions (mitigation: run targeted repro matrix + increased sampling). Owner: Priya N.
   - Canary traffic spike due to misrouted client (mitigation: circuit-breaker + traffic slice isolation). Owner: Evan B.
   - Config drift between hosted and dedicated causing SLO divergence (mitigation: config diff tooling run pre-rollout). Owner: Sofia G.
   - Post-deploy cache cold-starts increasing latency for first 10 minutes (mitigation: KV warmup + synthetic traffic priming). Owner: Aisha F.

5) Decisions made
   - Defer PR 412 from v1.13 canary; validate in small-batch opt-in first. (Decision: unanimous)
   - Move INFR-1299 hotfix to immediate smoke window once Marco confirms network repro.

6) Action items (owner — due)
   - Marco Liu — run networking repro matrix for INFR-1299 and update ticket (due: 2026-03-10 EOD).
   - Priya Natarajan — finish postmortem for RELENG-842 and propose autoscaler guardrail (due: 2026-03-12).
   - Evan Brooks — prepare canary observability dashboard with alerts (error budget, p99 latency) and hook tracing (due: 2026-03-11 12:00 PT).
   - Sofia Gomez — confirm dedicated host reimage window and notify affected customers (due: 2026-03-11).
   - Aisha Fernandez — run pre-canary config diff and KV warmup smoke run (due: 2026-03-11 23:00 UTC).

7) Handover notes for next conductor (evening shift)
   - Primary focus: verify Marco's repro for INFR-1299 and coordinate smoke window if green.
   - If KV warmup migration stalls, escalate to infra-ops (Slack: #infra-ops).
   - Monitor canary dashboards during the scheduled window; engage product on any quality regressions.

Appendix / quick links:
- Running smoke commands: conda run -n releng python tools/smoke_run.py --suite kv-warmup
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.company/pages/releng-postmortem-template
- Checklist snippet saved to: github.com/redwood-inference/releng/checklists/canary-preflight.md

Notes to self:
- Consider adding automated dependent-PR blocking in CI (if KV schema migration not present, fail canary).
- Follow up with model-onboarding team to ensure that dedicated-beta tenants have flags to opt out of experimental kernels.

End of handover.
